senses.gloss: to become impassionate, be hot with sexual passion.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 64a:9">Snh. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>דלא מִיגְּרֵי איניש בקרובתיה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="A00344"><he>איגרו</he></cite>) that one does not fall in love with his nearest kindred.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 22b:7">Ab. Zar. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>כיון דמיגרי בה</he> because the animal will show his sexual desire by running after her (and thus betray her sin).—Denom. <cite ref="V00092"><he>תִּגְרָא</he></cite>.
